decisions.reason: As a digital portal it is relatively far from the firm's core paper-display knowledge base, and with only limited visible market traction the firm is less likely to learn and improve it efficiently than it can with physical display products.

This packaging display solution builds directly on the firm's existing design, board-processing and customer-solution capabilities, and the 2024 packaging award is a strong signal that its knowledge can be applied commercially.

A quarter-pallet cardboard pegboard display is closely related to the firm's established temporary display business, so its in-house R&D and production know-how make continued refinement and retention likely.

The small cardboard counter display fits very closely with the firm's core competencies in standard and custom point-of-sale displays, giving it strong absorptive capacity to adapt and sell it further.

The large freestanding cardboard information display is a near-adjacent extension of the firm's existing display offer and can be supported well by its design, printing, assembly and logistics resources.
